summary: GitHub is giving away 2 years of Copilot Pro (worth $240) plus 100+ dev tools in the student pack. Students can verify their status through GitHub Education to unlock Copilot Pro, free domains, and free cloud credits.
claim_steps: Get a student email via UMGC application (fee waived until Sept 1).
Register a class so the @student.umgc.edu email activates.
Go to github.com/education/students and sign in.
Verify your .edu email and claim the student pack.
